verdict.rationale: dlt is a Python library that its docs say runs wherever Python runs: Airflow, Dagster, Lambda, serverless functions or a container. Its deploy walkthrough points to a GitHub Actions guide, and a CLI creates, inspects and deploys pipelines, so headless CI automation is a first-party documented path. missing for 10: detailed evidence of non-interactive CI configuration (e.g., secrets/credential injection in CI, exit codes), independent hands-on corroboration of CI runs

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Write the pipeline in Python and run it wherever Python already runs: a laptop, a notebook, Airflow, Dagster, a Lambda, a container.
try the GitHub Actions guide which has a generous free tier for anyone using GitHub
Creates, adds, inspects and deploys dlt pipelines.
dlt can be deployed anywhere Python runs, be it on Airflow, serverless functions
